comparisonToS310.s310Estimate: 17 sessions total (for all 800-series including case-bank EW, MCQ EW, Pack A closeout)
comparisonToS310.s311DomainEFOnly: 11 sessions (for Domain E+F only — ~65% of 800-series scope)
comparisonToS310.s310DomainEFImplied: ~9 sessions (phases 2-4: Domain E baseline + Domain F authoring + Domain E replacement)
comparisonToS310.deltaNote: S311 estimate is slightly higher (11 vs 9) because it includes full 5-gate quality workflow not assumed in S310. The extra 2 sessions are QA overhead.

throughputDegradation.scenario: Author burnout or complex items → throughput drops to 7/session

parallelizationFailure.scenario: File conflicts or sequencing errors prevent parallel execution

qualityGateBypass.scenario: QA gate skipped to accelerate throughput

recommendation: Proceed with 11 parallelized sessions. Maintain strict 5-gate quality workflow. Limit to 2 authoring sessions per day to prevent burnout. Rotate reviewers to prevent gate fatigue.
